          minor_client | eu_region | session_complete)
          enqueues send-consent-form with per-rule delay
      → send-consent-form worker
          re-validates rule + template + client
          creates consent_form_requests with fresh UUID token (30d expiry)
          fans out to channels:
            SMS  → Twilio direct (studio.twilio_phone_number or env fallback)
            Email → Resend direct (minimal inline HTML, react-email template
                   to be wired in a follow-up)
          per-channel client_communications audit rows
          permanent failures (missing env) drop the job; transient
          provider errors throw → BullMQ retries 3× exp backoff
